Start scripts (run each in its own terminal, alice first):
$RUN_DIR/start-alice.sh
$RUN_DIR/start-bob.sh
$RUN_DIR/start-charlie.sh

start-alice resumes Alice's conversation with a doubling delay until the resume time budget of 43200 s is spent, if her harness exits before the workflow is done; alice-sessions.jsonl records each launch, wait and her conversation ID.

Resume scripts (after a harness exit; no arguments normally needed):
$RUN_DIR/resume-alice.sh
$RUN_DIR/resume-bob.sh
$RUN_DIR/resume-charlie.sh

Alice kickoff prompt: $RUN_DIR/alice.prompt.md
